content: pest-plugin-arch rules that reference a namespace/directory with no files yet pass vacuously (silently) rather than erroring -- this is documented as intentional behavior so rules can be pre-declared for layers that don't exist yet. Consequence for Phase 1: architecture tests written against empty Gateway/Registry/Sync/Webhooks/Signals/Frontend namespaces will report green, but that green is NOT proof the rule fires. Phase 1 must additionally include a temporary violation-fixture test (a throwaway class placed in the wrong namespace importing a forbidden dependency) proving each rule actually fails when violated, per ROADMAP success criterion 2.
